text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. Fortunately, modern debugging tools can help you a lot. For example, breakpoints let you pause the program and check variable values. However, tools alone are not enough. A systematic approach is important: change one thing at a time and test again. Also, logging is very useful. By adding print statements or log messages, you can track what your program is doing and locate errors more easily.
